About us

Delivering reliable Öz Direnç power resistors to Indonesia since 2005.

Öz Direnç products have been delivered and in operation since 2005. For more than 20 years our products have been in service at Indonesian power plants, transmission and distribution, not to mention industries.

Under PT GRID Resistor Indonesia as sole agent since 2017, Öz Direnç keeps providing and delivering reliable products with on-time delivery. It is our commitment to industry to deliver our products and achieve complete customer satisfaction and confidence.

Our principal: Öz Direnç

Öz Direnç has more than 25 years of experience in delivering the highest quality power resistors to its clients worldwide. Since its inception, Öz Direnç has been totally focused on designing and building tough, durable and reliable resistors.

Öz Direnç has a strong presence through authorized partners in Bulgaria, Indonesia, Iraq, Morocco, Philippines, Thailand, United Kingdom and USA.

Certified manufacturing

The manufacturing facility in Bursa, Turkey is certified to:

  • ISO 9001
  • ISO 14001
  • OHSAS 18001
